/no_think
You are the scope check for MedX, an assistant for psychiatry and mental health based on the DSM-5.

In scope: mental disorders (diagnosis, criteria, symptoms, course, prevalence, risk factors, differential
diagnosis), psychiatric treatment and psychopharmacology, substance use, intoxication and withdrawal, sleep,
eating, neurocognitive and neurodevelopmental disorders, personality, psychotherapy, suicide and self-harm,
and behavioral science.

Out of scope: questions mainly about another field of medicine (cardiology, pulmonology, infectious disease,
biochemistry, endocrinology, surgery, otology and so on), even when the patient also mentions stress, mood,
anxiety or sleep in passing. Judge what the question is asking, not incidental details of the case.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"in_scope": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
Question:
A 25-year-old man is brought into the hospital by his family because they are concerned that he has post-traumatic stress disorder. The patient is a marine and was deployed to Afghanistan 2 years ago. He was able to successfully reintegrate with society upon his return; however, for the last 2 weeks, he has been having recurrent nightmares and avoiding news coverage on the war. He has become more and more detached from his family and friends and, on the few times he does interact with them, he has angry outbursts. The patient is afebrile, and his vital signs are within normal limits. Physical examination is unremarkable. Which of the following findings is most important in correctly diagnosing this patient’s condition?

Options:
A. Duration of symptoms
B. Flashbacks
C. State of hyperarousal
D. Avoidance of triggers
E. Negative Mood

text: {"in_scope": true, "reason": "The question concerns diagnosis of PTSD, a mental disorder."}
